headline: Stellar performance

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : ICIL’s consolidated revenues reported 57.5% YoY growth to Rs.1672.7cr in Q2FY27.
Core business (standalone) reported 38% YoY revenue growth while new business grew by more than 3x in Q2FY27.
Consolidated gross margins declined by 260bps YoY to 50.4% and EBITDA margins improved 417bps YoY to 13.9%.
EBITDA more than doubled to Rs.233cr while PAT grew ~3x YoY to Rs.176.3cr in Q2FY27.
